meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor revising a bid
gaps: Verify the revision entry identifies the exact vendor and actor who performed it.
Verify the revision entry contains the precise date and time.
Verify every activity line is in chronological order.
Verify that no earlier activity entries are missing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the revision entry identifies the exact vendor and actor who performed it.; Verify the revision entry contains the precise date and time.; Verify every activity line is in chronological order.; Verify that no earlier activity entries are missing.

steps.note: Create a test event so the bid revision and its activity are controlled within this plan.
A title is required to publish the event.
Use an RFQ stage because the case concerns a vendor revising a bid.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Invite one QA vendor to submit and revise a bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a second bid from the same vendor to represent a bid revision.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage’s Order Activity drawer from Settings.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Check that the activity view contains revision-related text for the vendor’s revised bid.
Check that the activity view identifies a QA vendor entry, although the exact vendor identity cannot be asserted dynamically.
